from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, math, csv, collections, platform
import numpy as np
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/"reports/seller_alias_continual/20260909/population_evaluation/20260909_210030"
run=root/"reports/seller_alias_continual/20260909/population_execution/20260909_162607/run"
e=json.loads((base/"evaluation/evaluation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
m=json.loads((run/"manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
orders=m["config"]["orders"]
columns=e["columns"]
assert orders==["ABC","BCA","CAB"] and len(e["groups"])==60
with (root/m["config"]["data_root"]/"groups.csv").open(encoding="utf-8",newline="") as f:
    meta={r["group_uid"]:r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
rows={d:np.array([i for i,g in enumerate(e["groups"]) if meta[g]["domain"]==d]) for d in "ABC"}
assert all(len(r)==20 for r in rows.values())
arrays={}; compared=0; maximum=0.; source=[]
def record(p):
    return {"path":p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def equal(a,b):
    global compared,maximum
    a,b=np.asarray(a,dtype=float),np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
    assert a.shape==b.shape
    diff=float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))) if a.size else 0.
    assert np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(b).all() and diff<1e-12,(a,b,diff)
    compared+=a.size
    maximum=max(maximum,diff)
def conf(c):
    tp,fp,fn,tn=[c[k] for k in ("tp","fp","fn","tn")]
    assert tp+fn==20 and fp+tn==358
    pr=tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else 0.
    re=tp/(tp+fn)
    sp=tn/(tn+fp)
    den=math.sqrt((tp+fp)*(tp+fn)*(tn+fp)*(tn+fn))
    return {"precision":pr,"recall":re,"specificity":sp,
            "f1":2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn) if 2*tp+fp+fn else 0.,
            "balanced_accuracy":(re+sp)/2,
            "mcc":(tp*tn-fp*fn)/den if den else 0.}
for o in orders:
    arrays[o]={}
    for point,r in e["orders"][o]["points"].items():
        p=base/"evaluation"/r["per_group_metrics"]["path"]
        rec=record(p)
        assert rec["bytes"]==r["per_group_metrics"]["bytes"]
        assert rec["sha256"]==r["per_group_metrics"]["sha256"]
        source.append(rec)
        a=np.load(p,allow_pickle=False)
        assert a.shape==(60,len(columns)) and np.isfinite(a).all()
        arrays[o][point]=a
        equal(a.mean(axis=0),[r["domain_equal"][k] for k in columns])
        for d in "ABC":
            equal(a[rows[d]].mean(axis=0),[r["by_domain"][d][k] for k in columns])
        for i,c in enumerate(r["per_group_confusion"]):
            for k,v in conf(c).items():
                equal(a[i,columns.index(k)],v)
        summed={k:sum(c[k] for c in r["per_group_confusion"]) for k in ("tp","fp","fn","tn")}
        assert summed==r["pooled_pair_metrics"]["confusion"]
        for k in ("brier","log_loss"):
            equal(a[:,columns.index(k)].mean(),r["pooled_pair_metrics"][k])
        # Pooled recall/specificity use common per-group positive/negative counts.
        for k in ("recall","specificity"):
            equal(a[:,columns.index(k)].mean(),r["pooled_pair_metrics"][k])
for arm,actual in e["final_fixed_order_equal"].items():
    p="shared" if arm=="frozen" else arm+"_stage3"
    expected=np.stack([arrays[o][p].mean(axis=0) for o in orders]).mean(axis=0)
    equal(expected,[actual[k] for k in columns])
for order in m["orders"]:
    o=order["order"]
    for arm,traj in order["trajectory"].items():
        for stage in (1,2,3):
            now=arrays[o][traj[stage]][:,0];before=arrays[o][traj[stage-1]][:,0]
            actual=e["orders"][o]["transitions"][arm][stage-1]
            d=o[stage-1]
            equal((now-before)[rows[d]].mean(),actual["new_domain_after_minus_before"])
            for learned in range(1,stage):
                d=o[learned-1];ri=rows[d]
                at=arrays[o][traj[learned]][:,0]
                history=[arrays[o][traj[t]][ri,0].mean() for t in range(learned,stage)]
                expected=[now[ri].mean()-at[ri].mean(),max(history)-now[ri].mean()]
                found=actual["old_domains"][d]
                equal(expected,[found["current_minus_when_learned"],found["best_previous_minus_current"]])
# Independent resampling of the SAME groups in every model/order, no evaluator imports.
rng=np.random.default_rng(20260909)
draws={d:rng.integers(0,20,size=(5000,20)) for d in "ABC"}
def interval(cells):
    mean=float(np.mean([v.mean() for _,_,v in cells]))
    boot=np.stack([v[draws[d]].mean(axis=1) for _,d,v in cells]).mean(axis=0)
    by_order={o:float(np.mean([v.mean() for oo,_,v in cells if oo==o])) for o in orders}
    return {"mean":mean,"conditional_95pct_interval":np.quantile(boot,[.025,.975]).tolist(),
            "per_order":by_order}
def final_difference(left,right,key="average_precision"):
    k=columns.index(key)
    lp="shared" if left=="frozen" else left+"_stage3"
    rp="shared" if right=="frozen" else right+"_stage3"
    return interval([(o,d,(arrays[o][lp]-arrays[o][rp])[rows[d],k]) for o in orders for d in "ABC"])
comparisons={left+"_minus_"+right:final_difference(left,right)
             for left,right in (("er","sequential"),("cumulative","sequential"),
                                ("sequential","frozen"),("er","frozen"))}
p=comparisons["er_minus_sequential"]
equal(p["mean"],e["primary_er_minus_sequential_ap"]["mean"])
equal(p["conditional_95pct_interval"],e["primary_er_minus_sequential_ap"]["conditional_95pct_interval"])
equal(list(p["per_order"].values()),e["primary_er_minus_sequential_ap"]["per_order"])
old=[]; gains={};oldchanges={};newall={};old_scores={}
for arm in ("frozen","sequential","er","cumulative"):
    cells_old=[];cells_new=[];cells_old_scores=[]
    for order in m["orders"]:
        o=order["order"];traj=order["trajectory"][arm]
        for learned in (1,2):
            d=o[learned-1]
            v=arrays[o][traj[3]][rows[d],0]-arrays[o][traj[learned]][rows[d],0]
            cells_old.append((o,d,v))
            cells_old_scores.append((o,d,arrays[o][traj[3]][rows[d],0]))
        for stage in (2,3):
            d=o[stage-1]
            cells_new.append((o,d,(arrays[o][traj[stage]]-arrays[o][traj[stage-1]])[rows[d],0]))
    oldchanges[arm]=interval(cells_old)
    old_scores[arm]=interval(cells_old_scores)
    newall[arm]=interval(cells_new)
    gains[arm]={}
    for stage in (1,2,3):
        cells=[]
        for order in m["orders"]:
            o=order["order"];tr=order["trajectory"][arm];d=o[stage-1]
            cells.append((o,d,(arrays[o][tr[stage]]-arrays[o][tr[stage-1]])[rows[d],0]))
        gains[arm][str(stage)]=interval(cells)
    if arm in ("sequential","er"):
        for o in orders:
            for t in e["orders"][o]["transitions"][arm][1:]:
                for d,r in t["old_domains"].items():
                    old.append({"order":o,"arm":arm,"stage":t["stage"],"domain":d,**r})
first_domain_scores={o:{d:float(arrays[o]["shared"][rows[d],0].mean()) for d in "ABC"} for o in orders}
initial_equal=float(np.mean([arrays[o]["initial"][:,0].mean() for o in orders]))
training=[]
for o in m["orders"]:
    for arm in ("shared","sequential","er","cumulative"):
        logs=[o["training"][arm]] if arm=="shared" else o["training"][arm]
        for i,r in enumerate(logs):
            counts=collections.Counter(r["current_group_ids"])
            assert set(counts.values())=={3}
            assert r["updates"]==len(r["current_group_ids"]) and r["current_pair_presentations"]==378*r["updates"]
            equal(float(r["replay_pair_presentations"]),float(len(r["replay_group_ids"])*378))
            rc=collections.Counter(r["replay_group_ids"])
            previous="shared" if i==0 else "er_stage2"
            if arm=="er":
                assert len(rc)==6 and set(rc)==set(o["points"][previous]["memory"]["retained_groups"])
            training.append({"order":o["order"],"arm":arm,"stage":1 if arm=="shared" else i+2,
                             **{k:r[k] for k in ("updates","training_seconds","current_bce_mean","replay_bce_mean",
                                 "maximum_gradient_norm_before_clip")},
                             "replay_group_counts":dict(rc)})
equal(sum(r["training_seconds"] for r in training),m["formal_training_seconds"])
assert sum(r["updates"] for r in training)==5400
inference=sum(p["timing"]["inference_seconds_including_replay"] for o in m["orders"] for p in o["points"].values())
point_total=sum(p["timing"]["total_point_seconds"] for o in m["orders"] for p in o["points"].values())
equal(inference,m["formal_inference_seconds_including_replay"])
initial_states=[o["points"]["initial"]["model_state_sha256"] for o in m["orders"]]
assert len(set(initial_states))==1
log_events=[]
for line in (run.parent/"train.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
    if line.startswith("{"):log_events.append(json.loads(line))
assert sum(x.get("event")=="point_reloaded" for x in log_events)==25
updates_events=[x for x in log_events if x.get("event")=="updates"]
assert len(updates_events)==5400//30
for r in training:
    arm="sequential" if r["arm"]=="shared" else r["arm"]
    ev=[x for x in updates_events if x["order"]==r["order"] and x["stage"]==r["stage"] and x["arm"]==arm]
    assert [x["completed"] for x in ev]==list(range(30,r["updates"]+1,30))
runtime=m["runtime_check"]["runtime_check_seconds"]
timing={"formal_training_seconds":m["formal_training_seconds"],
        "required_runtime_check_seconds":runtime,"formal_two_pass_scoring_seconds":inference,
        "formal_point_other_state_seconds":point_total-inference,
        "remaining_loading_retained_models_and_orchestration_seconds":
        m["budget"]["elapsed_seconds"]-m["formal_training_seconds"]-runtime-point_total,
        "runner_elapsed_seconds":m["budget"]["elapsed_seconds"],
        "process_elapsed_from_time_log":"3:31:29","started_shell_local":"2026-09-09T16:29:00+08:00",
        "finished_shell_local":"2026-09-09T20:00:30+08:00"}
per_group_ap={o:{p:a[:,0].tolist() for p,a in points.items()} for o,points in arrays.items()}
result={"status":"PASS_INDEPENDENT_SAVED_METRICS_AND_EXECUTION_AUDIT",
 "scope":"No labels, owners, old truth, model deserialization or retraining; saved valid metrics/counts and run logs only.",
 "sources":[record(base/"evaluation/evaluation.json"),record(run/"manifest.json"),*source],
 "numeric_values_recompared":int(compared),"maximum_absolute_difference":maximum,
 "metric_files_verified":24,"formal_score_points":24,"training_stages":21,"physical_updates":5400,
 "observed_budget":m["budget"],"timing":timing,"training_stages_detail":training,
 "initial_domain_equal_ap":initial_equal,"final_metrics":e["final_fixed_order_equal"],
 "ap_comparisons":comparisons,"new_domain_gains_by_stage":gains,
 "later_new_domain_gain_mean":newall,"final_old_domain_minus_when_learned":oldchanges,
 "final_old_domain_scores":old_scores,"old_domain_observations":old,
 "shared_scores_seen_and_unseen_domains":first_domain_scores,
 "group_order":e["groups"],"group_domains":[meta[g]["domain"] for g in e["groups"]],
 "per_group_ap":per_group_ap,
 "uncertainty":"Frozen 5000 within-domain full-group paired bootstrap, seed 20260909. Secondary intervals are descriptive, unadjusted and conditional on fixed data, initialization, orders. Max-based forgetting reported as point estimates only.",
 "primary_endpoint_unchanged":True,"new_semantic_label_reads":0}
target=base/"independent_audit.json"
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ("status","numeric_values_recompared","maximum_absolute_difference",
 "timing","ap_comparisons","later_new_domain_gain_mean","final_old_domain_minus_when_learned")}))

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
base=Path("reports/seller_alias_continual/20260909/population_evaluation/20260909_210030")
a=json.loads((base/"independent_audit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
e=json.loads((base/"evaluation/evaluation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
m=json.loads(Path("reports/seller_alias_continual/20260909/population_execution/20260909_162607/run/manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
result={"scope":"User requested other metrics. Descriptive trajectories from already saved valid metrics; no new label parse, threshold selection, primary change or new experiment.",
        "metrics":{},"label_reads":0,"new_tests_or_training":False}
for key in e["columns"]:
    table={}
    for order in m["orders"]:
        o=order["order"];points=e["orders"][o]["points"]
        for arm,tr in order["trajectory"].items():
            r=table.setdefault(arm,{"final_old_minus_when_learned":[],"old_observations":[],
                                    "later_new_after_minus_before":[]})
            for learned in (1,2):
                d=o[learned-1]
                v=points[tr[3]]["by_domain"][d][key]-points[tr[learned]]["by_domain"][d][key]
                r["final_old_minus_when_learned"].append({"order":o,"domain":d,"change":v})
            for stage in (2,3):
                d=o[stage-1]
                r["later_new_after_minus_before"].append({"order":o,"stage":stage,"domain":d,
                    "change":points[tr[stage]]["by_domain"][d][key]-points[tr[stage-1]]["by_domain"][d][key]})
                for learned in range(1,stage):
                    d=o[learned-1]
                    now=points[tr[stage]]["by_domain"][d][key]
                    at=points[tr[learned]]["by_domain"][d][key]
                    hist=[points[tr[t]]["by_domain"][d][key] for t in range(learned,stage)]
                    best=min(hist) if key in ("brier","log_loss") else max(hist)
                    r["old_observations"].append({"order":o,"stage":stage,"domain":d,
                        "current_minus_when_learned":now-at,
                        "deterioration_from_best_previous":now-best if key in ("brier","log_loss") else best-now})
    for arm,r in table.items():
        r["final"]=e["final_fixed_order_equal"][arm][key]
        r["mean_final_old_change"]=float(np.mean([v["change"] for v in r["final_old_minus_when_learned"]]))
        r["mean_later_new_change"]=float(np.mean([v["change"] for v in r["later_new_after_minus_before"]]))
        sign=-1 if key in ("brier","log_loss") else 1
        r["final_old_improved_count"]=sum(sign*v["change"]>1e-12 for v in r["final_old_minus_when_learned"])
        r["final_old_deteriorated_count"]=sum(sign*v["change"]<-1e-12 for v in r["final_old_minus_when_learned"])
        r["old_best_deterioration_count"]=sum(v["deterioration_from_best_previous"]>1e-12 for v in r["old_observations"])
    result["metrics"][key]=table
p=base/"metric_trajectories.json"
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
for key in ("average_precision","map","mrr","recall_at_1","recall_at_3","recall_at_5","recall_at_10",
            "ndcg_at_10","recall","precision","f1","brier","log_loss"):
    print(json.dumps({"metric":key,"arms":{arm:{k:r[k] for k in ("final","mean_final_old_change","mean_later_new_change",
       "final_old_improved_count","final_old_deteriorated_count","old_best_deterioration_count")} for arm,r in result["metrics"][key].items()}}))
